name: x-poster
description: Post a tweet or thread (with optional image) to X. Preview cost first; never auto-publishes.

tools.name: preview_post
tools.description: Validate + cost-preview a tweet/thread. No side effects.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Post to X after explicit confirmation. The only writer.

tools.name: authorize
tools.description: Connect your X account — returns a link to click. One-time, no terminal.

tools.name: auth_instructions
tools.description: Setup help (X app checklist + auth options).

X_CLIENT_ID.title: X API Client ID
X_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth2 client ID from your X Developer App

X_CLIENT_SECRET.title: X API Client Secret
X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth2 client secret from your X Developer App

X_REFRESH_TOKEN.title: X Refresh Token (optional)
X_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Leave blank — after installing, just ask Claude to run the authorize tool and click the link. (Power users: paste a token minted via bin/x-auth.mjs instead.)
